## Walkthrough

The StatefulSet e2e test imports metav1 for Pod ObjectMeta, moves the conflicting StatefulSet declaration outward, waits for its ReadyReplicas=1, asserts no workload name collision, and performs two ordered deletion-and-await teardown sequences for the conflicting and original StatefulSets (Pods and Workloads).

## Changes

**StatefulSet Conflict Test Refactoring**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Add metav1 import and Pod ObjectMeta** <br> `test/e2e/singlecluster/baseline/statefulset_test.go`|Adds the `metav1` import to build `corev1.Pod` `ObjectMeta` for teardown assertions.|
|**Conflict handling, readiness wait, and ordered teardown** <br> `test/e2e/singlecluster/baseline/statefulset_test.go`|Moves `conflictingStatefulSet` declaration outward, creates it and waits for `ReadyReplicas=1`, fetches the conflicting Workload and asserts created workload names differ, then deletes the conflicting StatefulSet and awaits deletion of its `-0` Pod and Workload, then deletes the original StatefulSet and awaits deletion of its `-0` Pod and Workload.|
